A '''creeper''' is a hostile mob that quickly runs toward the hero before exploding within melee range.

== Spawning ==
Creepers can spawn throughout the following missions:
{{columns-list|
* {{DuLevelLink|Creeper Woods}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Creepy Crypt}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Woodland Mansion}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Woodland Prison}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Soggy Swamp}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Soggy Cave}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Pumpkin Pastures}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Arch Haven}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Cacti Canyon}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Spider Cave}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Redstone Mines}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Fiery Forge}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Desert Temple}} ([[MCD:Arcade|Arcade]])
* {{DuLevelLink|Highblock Halls}} (outside)
* {{DuLevelLink|Underhalls}} (cellar)
* {{DuLevelLink|Dingy Jungle}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Panda Plateau}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Overgrown Temple}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Frozen Fjord}} (Arcade)
* {{DuLevelLink|Gale Sanctum}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Gauntlet of Gales}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Colossal Rampart}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Radiant Ravine}} ([[MCD:Secret|secret area]])
* {{DuLevelLink|The Stronghold}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Daily Trial}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Ancient Hunt}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Tower}}
* {{DuLevelLink|Treetop Tangle}}
}}

Creepers can also spawn during [[MCD:Night Mode|night mode]], regardless of the [[MCD:Mission Select|mission]], when at least one hero dies in multiplayer.

== Behavior ==
Creepers become passive if an {{MCD|ocelot}} is nearby. They also run away if they are currently being attacked by an ocelot.

=== Ignition ===
When within range of a target, creepers ignite themselves, which also increases their movement speed (unlike the base game in which ignited creepers cannot move). After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing heavy damage to heroes within the explosion's radius.
